page_title: SAS 0-2 CAG | Sassuolo v Cagliari 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Daniele Doveri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+5' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) works the corner short.

90+3' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is given a second yellow card for his behaviour. He said too much to the referee and Daniele Doveri sent him off. One can only wonder what was going on his head. He has weakened his team.
90+3' A yellow card for bad language! Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
90+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Andrea Consigli gets a hand on the penalty from Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
90+1' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
89' The referee signals a substitution. Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Nahitan Nandez.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.

87' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
86' It's time for a substitution. Adam Obert (Cagliari) comes on in place of Tommaso Augello.
81' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
80' The game is interrupted. Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
79' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
76' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) sees a yellow card from Daniele Doveri after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

71' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Matteo Prati (Cagliari) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Andrea Consigli, so the score changes to 0:1.
69' A long ball forward to Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) is intercepted.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Prati (Cagliari) replaces Alessandro Deiola.
67' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) replaces Gianluca Gaetano.
65' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) offside.
62' Substitution. Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ruan Tressoldi walks off.
61' What was Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' It's a nice effort by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Andrea Consigli. Easy save.
58' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
57' A substitution has been made. Kristian Thorstvedt is replaced by Pedro Obiang (Sassuolo).
57' Davide Ballardini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) replacing Uros Racic.
56' It doesn’t look good for Uros Racic (Sassuolo); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
54' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
54' Sassuolo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
51' Cagliari have a corner.
50' Cagliari work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

50' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The linesman points to the corner flag, Cagliari are going to take it.
49' Neat passing move from Cagliari in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Zito Luvumbo comes on the pitch for Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
46' Half-time substitution. Davide Ballardini decided to make a change. Filippo Missori (Sassuolo) is replaced by Gregoire Defrel.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

43' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
42' Sassuolo are ruled offside.
39' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andrea Consigli intercepts the ball.

37' That was close by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
36' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
35' A lofted cross from Josh Doig (Sassuolo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
33' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
28' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

25' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
22' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Doveri interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
21' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) takes the corner which is cleared.
20' Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch because Martin Erlic simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
18' The injury to Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
16' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Cagliari.
14' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes it short.
13' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul. Sassuolo are awarded the free kick.
13' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
12' Great teamplay by Cagliari as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes.
8' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cagliari for a penalty. Play continues.
6' The Sassuolo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' The foul by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) was seen by Daniele Doveri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
2' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Doveri.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
